comparison.input: layer0 pos0 measured; pos1 functional; frozen actual untrained activation
comparison.window: ordinary boundary call + one common FP32 quantization + three complete QKV projections + return
comparison.each_window_warmup: one full same-method boundary; identical prepare, same addresses
comparison.scope: this input and shared scalar quantizer, not globally optimal RVV or entire transformer

pre_run_required_gates: final P3 host result PASS and all source/ELF/runtime hashes unchanged
read current collaboration protections and available memory/CPU/disk
new 0f identity adapter, no weakening old T17 gate
new actual-ELF retired/CSR/O2 observer binding and full128 checks
local 3 percent selector plus false gain/anchor/stopping negative controls
first custom PC/word/vd and bit100 fixture normal-library binding
actual target overhead/log volume and 7200s feasibility admission
write immutable run freeze of runner/code/contracts/images/inputs before first process
legacy_metadata_policy: Host seed image may retain source UART contract string; local signed-off run metadata must explicitly map its exact SHA to this contract. Never call donor runner or use 199/200 qualification. If code/image changes, redo affected host gates and create new image freeze.

processes.success: known first custom, only bit100 mismatch and explicit injection evidence; general crash is not PASS

processes.precondition: negative PASS plus budget admission PASS
processes.success: complete functional + exact plan + DiffTest + observer + all controls + anchor + >=3pct gain

processes.precondition: all normal gates including anchor/gain PASS
processes.success: same exact functional/plan/instret/cycles/CSR and custom signatures, all corresponding windows equal

budget_qualification.limitation: Old C8 rate and donor QKV cycles are different workloads/runtime histories, not a guaranteed QKV ETA. 18M is a ceiling; wall limit may stop much earlier. No launch if feasibility evidence is insufficient.

stop_rules: any gate failure stops campaign without next process
timeout/RSS/log/guest limit is incomplete budget outcome, not mathematical performance failure
no sample deletion or automatic retries/expansion
replay is reproducibility not extra independent sample
do not run target this round
